notes.title: Updates / Patches
notes.content:
Here are the list of updates that have been submitted to resolve the issues being discussed and brought up in the community hub.

Most recent updates:
- Faceoffs animation and logic improved to allow for more clean draws.
- Players going wild due a rematch related issue is now resolved.
- Goalie can now be user controlled to pass the puck in any direction.
- Odd man rushes minimized by restricting defencemen to change only on offense and forwards only during forecheck.
- Fighting time out added to advance play in cases of physics errors.
- Switching of players has been updated to allow for better defence.
- Powerplay and the last minute of the period is slowed down by half.
- Fighting can now be turned on or off via options menu.

Previous updates:
- Delays in input control for passing and shooting resolved.
- Separation of players tuned to allow for better skating control.
- Player stats showing incorrect goalie stats resolved.
- Slower gameplay defence animations speed improved.
- Multiple players incorrectly reaching for the same loose puck resolved.
- End of game crash resolved when the scores go over 20 goals.
- End of game crash resolved when guest user finishes story game.
- GAA calculations in Box Score fixed.
- Title screen auto play takes the settings of the initial user rather than defaults.
- Optimizations to help reduce slow down due to memory allocations.
- Block Shot help added to Controller Help screen.
- Prefer Up camera settings fixed.
- Block Shot control help added to Settings screen.
- Objectives based on shots are now correctly logged.
- Arcade Effects can be turned off in Story Mode.
- Shooting directions fixed for Broadcast Camera.
- Les Voyous and Widowmakers jersey textures updated.
- Timber Cats stadium crowd capacity adjusted for better frame rate.
- Controller Vibration enabled.
- Broadcast camera relative shooting directions enabled.
- Leaderboard win/loss data being initialized incorrectly on ties is fixed.
- Player Stats in Story Mode is sorted by points.
- Stats and progression being incorrectly saved due to region culture is resolved.
- Invalid objective description string causing a crash in French SKU has been resolved.
- Shooting settings for camera relative direction is fixed.
- Keyboard support added.
- Crowd optimizations added.
- Fixes for Playoff related crashes due to invalid Tie Break settings.
- Shot tuning revised to lower the amount of misses.
- Player steering values for passing is updated.
- Tutorials included in the How To Play screen.
- Story Mode Plus team select fixed to include Hinto Brews.
- Achievements not being triggered have been resolved.
- Added Launch Options parameters to set windowed, run borderless, run custom resolutions, skip resolution select screen, turn vsync off, turn multi-sampling off.
- Advanced input preset is now unlocked by default.
- Story Mode can now be played with all input presets.
- Tutorials delivered through objectives are stripped out.
- Progression related objectives are now optional.
- Difficulty and Gameplay settings can be changed in Story Mode at any point in the season.
- Cheat code will now unlock Story Mode Plus and Alternate Jerseys instead.
- Goalie crash fixes for Story Mode scripted game.
- Story Mode objective descriptions improved for more clarity.
- Rematches in Story Mode causing incorrect tutorials has been resolved.
- Faceoffs are adjusted to draw correctly when neither controller attempts a draw.
- User controlled players skating in wild direction upon gaining control has been resolved.
- Input delays when gaining control of the puck have been resolved.
- Controller settings related help descriptions updated to improve clarity.
- NIS fade in and fade out related issues upon rematch of games have been resolved.
- Contains fixes for a crash on faceoff.
- Model file udpated to fix skinning issues.
- Two-Button, Retro, and Beer Mode control schemes updated to allow for hip-checks when the bodycheck button is held.
- Volume settings slider fixed for values below 100.
- Arcade Effects can't be turned off during Story Mode.
- Instigation pairs don't include invalid injured players.
